fact: GEOGLAM's account by the project leads says the Ghana Space Science and Technology Institute and VITO are building the GEOMAIZE maize yield estimation from Sentinel-2 time series, with Ghana having a foundation for an operational pipeline.

SERVIR West Africa and the University of Florida report that GMet successfully tested initial operational capability of CRAFT for district-level maize yield hindcasts in Ghana, linking earth-observation crop type maps to production forecasts, with operationalising the service listed as a next step.

ESA states that VITO built Earth-observation crop classifiers from nearly 800 FSRP field points collected in August-September 2023, trained Ministry of Food and Agriculture officials in March 2024, and adapted a Ghana CLIMTAG dashboard, with Ghana planning to operationalise it in the GhAAP platform.
